What an absolutely magnificent pile of garbage.

Brawlhalla is genuinely one of the worst gaming experiences ever conceived by mankind. Imagine Super Smash Bros, remove all the fun, inject concentrated rage directly into the gameplay and give every player a crippling superiority complex. Congratulations, you've invented Brawlhalla.

The game has approximately 700 weapons, yet somehow every single opponent manages to use the most annoying one imaginable. Scythe mains are unemployed anime protagonists, Lance mains have never experienced human interaction, and Mordex players need their hard drives investigated.

The matchmaking is absolutely phenomenal. Nothing quite compares to being matched against someone with 4,000 hours, a diamond border and the reaction speed of a fucking cheetah when you're just trying to enjoy a casual game.

And the taunting. OH, THE TAUNTING. Apparently winning a 1v1 against someone with half your playtime is a monumental achievement worthy of a presidential medal.

The ranked system is less of a competitive environment and more of a government-approved torture facility. You gain 20 Elo, lose 25, and suddenly your entire afternoon has been wasted.

Pros:

    Free to play (unfortunately).

    Has some decent character designs (petra a baddie).

    Occasionally enjoyable when nobody is playing.

Cons:

    Everything else.

    Scythe players.

    Lance players.

    Mordex players.

    The matchmaking.

    The community.

    The fact that I keep reinstalling it.

Final verdict: 0/10.

Your dopamine from winning turns into dependency. 
Your disappointment from loss turns into despair. 
You will be pulled into a purgatory in which you cannot find joy and cannot escape misery.
Casual becomes caustic, ranked becomes rancid.

Play the 'for free' version for 100 hours and then purge this game from your library.

i have such mixed feelings on this game. The actual gameplay itself is quite good. 
You have quite a variety of weapons, also the game didn't charge me for a F2P experience the way rivals of aether 1 and 2 did.

but my god is this shit so goddamn obnoxious. the choice of emojis, the character designs. the players themselves, the fact only like half a fucking dozen characters are playable when you start, the out of date newgroundsish art style (although from talking to others. many do seem to really like this artstyle, so maybe there's something to it idk.) ,the fact there's literally not even a setting to change your resolution. I get why people hate this game even if I've been having fun, as it just feels so incredibly amateur. And not in a good or really charming kinda way. Like i can't reasonably recommend this game to most people, because this game only really appeals to me because of my kinda odd taste in games. but it is still worth playing if you enjoy platform fighters and have a particularly self hating taste in games.
